sloka: तद्यथा तस्य विक्रान्तमनुरूपं महात्मनः ।भवेदाहवशूरस्य तथा त्वमुपपादय ।। ५.३९.३१।।।।
transliteration: tadyathā tasya vikrāntamanurūpaṁ mahātmanaḥ ।bhavedāhavaśūrasya tathā tvamupapādaya ।। 5.39.31।।।।

translations.english: "You may make arrangement in such a manner that, that great self, the hero in war makes his victorious march which is worthy of him."
